tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250snyan brgyud ma mo'i mdos kyi las 'grigs bzhugs/1$0000300 oṃ swasti/

snyan brgyud ma mo'i mdos kyi skabs/ thog mar las gzhung bsrang*/ bzlas pa'i skabs dzap khang phyes nas/ mdos dkyil gyi gtor ma dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam la bzlas pa sgrub sngags gtsor bton dang*/ tshe sgrub bzlas dmigs bcas gzhung ltar/ las sbyor ting nge 'dzin gyi srung zlog byed na gshin rje'i thugs tig ltar gsal btab nas sgrub sngags la srung zlog gi sngags btags pa ci rigs bzla/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bsad pa byed na/ dmigs pa gsal nas sgrub sngags la e myag btags pa cung zad bzla zhing thun la'ang bsngags/ stong tshigs mchod bstod rjes gtor bsngo dang skong bshags sogs ci rigs bya/ tshogs yang dag ltar dang*/ spro na skong ba ci rigs bya/ de nas bsgral las mdor bsdus la/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung grub pa'i lha// ma mo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas// shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa/ khrag 'thung yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod// ces bskul/ gser skyems brlab/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ khyad par srid pa ma mo'i lha tshogs rnams// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed// gzu dang dpang mdzod mngon spyod las la bzhengs// nyams pa bsgral ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// ma mo'i rol pa'i srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras// bka' nyan bran g.yog mngags gzhug bcas rnams kyis// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed// gzu dang dpang mdzod mngon spyod las la bzhengs// nyams pa bsgral ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// rnal 'byor bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dang*// sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag /lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lhas// gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed// gzu dang dpang mdzod mngon spyod las la bzhengs// nyams pa bsgral ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod//

ces dang hom bskyed/ dgug gzhug spyi ltar mthar sgrub sngags la/ dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ā kar+ṣā ya: ā kar+ṣā ya: nā sha ya: nā sha ya: ha ra ha ra: mo ha ya mo ha ya: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes btags pa lan gsum/ e: khro rgyal 'dus pa yungs dkar thog: ma mo khrag gi rba rlabs 'khrugs: klu bdud dug gi kha chu 'beb: thibs gnon gdug pa rdo rje'i mtshe: gza' rgod mig dmar gzer mda' 'phen: gshin rje srog gcod zangs lcags char: mtshon cha sna tshogs rdo yi thun: 'beb pa ma mo'i sprul pas 'beb: 'ben ni dgra dang bgegs la bcas: nyams pa'i lus sems rdul du rlog: rtsa ba'i sngags dang mtshon chas gzir: e myags ya rngubs mug shaka ka dun: dgra bo'i srog la breng hur thum dza rtsa khrag snying thums ril raṃ shag rbad: srog thum ril dza rtsa khrag hur raṃ: snying thun rbad srog la mā ra ya bh+yo: zhes thun brdeg /phur pa thogs la/ hūm̐/ nga ni mngon rdzogs khrag 'thung dpal// sras dang sprul pa bye ba 'bum// bka' sdod rab 'jigs pho nyar bcas// g.yas kyi phyag na lcags kyu thogs// g.yon gyi phyag na phur pa 'dril// lcags kyus zungs la phur pas thobs// tshe bsod sgrub mchog rnams la stims// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor// sha khrag tshogs kyi mchod par bzhes// sgrub sngags dang*/ e myags ya rngubs mug shaka ka dun: dgra bo'i srog la breng hur thum dza rtsa khrag snying thums ril raṃ shag rbad: srog thum ril dza rtsa khrag hur raṃ: snying thun rbad srog la mā ra ya bh+yo: zhes btags pa bzlas nas phur pas bsgral/ e: mngon rdzogs khrag 'thung rol pa'i mtshon: shes rab ral gri rnon po yis: dgra bgegs gzugs brnyan dum bur gtubs: tshe dang bsod nams rang la 'dus: rnam shes dmigs med chos dbyings thim: sha khrag khro bo rngams pa'i tshogs: dgyes pa chen po'i zhal du bstab:

mngon spyod phrin las mthar phyin mdzod: e hur thums khaḍ+ga tīk+ṣ+ṇa hri dir mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gtubs la zhal bstab bya/ de nas mdos kyi dkor cha sngags drug phyag drug gis brlab/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni bla na med pa sogs kyis mdos mgron spyan drangs/ bh+yo: dang po ci yang ma srid sogs kyis phul/ grangs gsog byin rlabs nas skong mdos dang*/ zlog mdos/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bde gshegs mthu stobs 'dus pa'i dpal: mngon rdzogs rgyal po he ru ka: yab yum sprul pa yang 'khor sogs: srid pa ma mo'i lha tshogs rnams/ dbyings las ye shes sku ru bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: mngon spyod dmod pa'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: dug gsum rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog: ma rig rnam rtog las byung ba'i: gdon bgegs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: kun brtags 'khrul pa las byung ba'i: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: gzhan dbang 'pho 'gyur las byung ba'i: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad zlog: phyi don bden zhen las byung ba'i: 'byung bzhi phyi yi g.yo 'khrug zlog: rtsa rlung thig le las byung ba'i: rnal 'byor nang gi bar chad zlog: nga bdag 'gong po las byung ba'i: gzung 'dzin gsang ba'i sun ma zlog: 'dod chags sred zhen las byung ba'i: snod bcud dbul zhing phongs pa zlog: zhe sdang gdug sems las byung ba'i: byad phur rbod gtong mtshon 'khrugs zlog: gti mug rmongs pa las byung ba'i: dam sri kla klo'i 'tshe ba zlog: nga rgyal khengs sems las byung ba'i: dregs pa sde brgyad cho 'phrul zlog: phrag dog gdug rtsub las byung ba'i: 'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug zlog: zlog go mi mthun rnam rtog tshogs: gzhi dbyings ka dag klong du zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sems byung kun: gzhi snang lhun grub chen por sgyur:

thams cad 'od gsal gnyug ma'i dbyings: 'khrul pa dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: sarba sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces gshin rje'i thugs tig ltar bskyed/ de nas bsad mdos/ bh+yo: dbyings nyid ma bcos sogs sngags bcas/ sgrub sngags mthar/ sarba maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ badz+rod bha ba u triṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes pas zor dkyil nam mkhar bteg hūm̐ bh+yo: chos nyid dbyings las sogs nang sgo dbye zhing*/ gser skyems dang bcas/ hūm̐/ ma mo rol pa'i sogs phyi sgo dbye/ 'phang ba dngos ni/ lhag ma dang*/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul dang*/ chad tho sbrel mthar/ hūm̐ bh+yo: lcags saṃ bhan+dha'i snod nang du: sha khrag dug mtshon gtor ma bshams: snang srid gzhir bzhengs mdos chen po: 'phang ba mngon rdzogs rgyal pos 'phen: dmigs pa dgra dang bgegs la gtad: las ni nyams pa rdul du brlag: dgra dpung bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: bgegs dpung thal ba'i rdul du rlogs: ming tsam med par phung du chugs: mngon spyod phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: sngags mthar/ ma ma ru lu ru lu baṃ bh+yo: dgra bgegs nṛ tri thun longs bh+yo: snying khrag tsa dzaḥrbad bh+yo: zhes bsad mdos kyi sngags bcas 'phang*/ yang zlog pa/ brtan skyong*/ rta bro// tshe 'gugs sogs spyi ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang mañdzu gho ṣas so// shu bhaṃ/// /
